page.layout: Two columns of dictionary entries, left and right, divided by a vertical rule. The running head "ש ת" stands at the top of each column. Below the text, at the right, is the signature "ת א". There are no marginal notes.

main_text.p: שָׁת nates, No. sing. masc. à Rad. שׁת, contr. שָׁת posuit.
שָׁתָה posuit, f. praet. Kal, 3. f. f. Rad. שׁת, contr. שָׁת.
שְׁתוֹ bibere, Infin. Kal, & שְׁתוּ bibete, Imper. Kal, pl. m. Rad. שָׁתָה.
מִשְּׁתוֹ à ferendo illo, vel, de excellentia ejus, contractè, pro מְשַׂאתוֹ Infin. Kal, vel potiùs, No. f. f. שָׂאת, præf. aff. Rad. נָשָׂא tulit.
שְׁתוֹתָיו fundamenta, ejus, No. pl. fæm. aff. Rad. שׁוּת, contr. שָׁת posuit.
לִשְׁתּוֹת ad bibendum, Inf. Kal, præf. R. שָׁתָה.
שְׁתוֹתֵיהֶם nates ipsarum, pl. f. aff. à f. m. שׁת, Rad. שׁוּת, contr. שָׁת posuit.
שָׁתִי posui, pro שָׁתִּתִּי, praet. Kal, 1. f. Rad. שׁוּת, contr. שָׁת.
הַשָּׁתִי stamen, compotatio, בְּשָׁתִי in compotatione, שְׁתִיָּה potio, No. f. m. præf. & No. sing. fæm. Rad. שָׁתָה bibit.
שֹׁתִים bibentes, לִשְׁתָּיו bibentibus eam, Ben. Kal, pl. m. constr. aff. & præf. R. שָׁתָה.
שְׁתַּיִם, constr. שְׁתֵי duæ, שְׁתַּיִהֶן duæ illæ, pro שְׁנָתַּיִם, No. du. f. constr. aff. à du. m. שְׁנַיִם; Rad. שָׁנָה iterare.
שְׁתִיתִי bibi, praet. Kal, 1. f. Rad. שָׁתָה.
שָׁתַם obstruxit, cum ש, pro ס, praet. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. סָתַם.
שְׁתַנִי posuisti me, praet. Kal, 2. f. m. aff. Rad. שׁוּת, contr. שָׁת.

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points and some letters are hard to read at this scan resolution and may be wrong in places; the Hebrew forms are transcribed as closely as the image allows. The first entry is a continuation from the previous page. The left-column entry "שָׁתִי posui" runs over into the right column at "Kal, 1. f. Rad." and is printed here as one entry. The printed "contracté" is given as "contractè". The page number is printed at the top right as 415.
